questions.count: For the GET /app/ capture window from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z through 00:04:59Z inclusive, how many responses had status 502 and how many requests had no response status?
questions.example: For the same GET /app/ capture window from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z through 00:04:59Z inclusive, give the 502 and missing-status counts and inspect one concrete 502 example. Include its ID and request path.
questions.comparison: Compare /settings in the two supplied synthetic responses. Which functional field changed, from what value to what value? Distinguish timestamp noise and state whether coverage was complete.
